page_title: REI 1-1 LEN | Reims v Lens 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+5' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Lens get a corner.
90+4' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles over the bar.
90+3' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+1' Reims fail to score from a corner as Brice Samba (Lens) leaps to collect the ball.
90+1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Keito Nakamura (Reims). Corner kick. Reims will have an opportunity.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' A long pass, executed by Thomas Foket (Reims), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
89' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Therence Koudou (Reims) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
88' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Jhoanner Chavez and he is replaced by Massadio Haidara (Lens).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Junya Ito departs the field of play to be replaced by Benjamin Stambouli (Reims).

86' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Reims are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
85' The cross fools the defence and leaves Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergio Akieme leaves the pitch and Therence Koudou (Reims) comes on.
82' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mohamed Daramy (Reims) replacing Teddy Teuma.
82' Angelo Fulgini goes off the pitch and David Pereira da Costa (Lens) comes on.
81' An attempted cross from Florian Sotoca (Lens) is cleared.

79' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
78' 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
76' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
74' Reims have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' The ball is cleared after Florian Sotoca (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
71' Here is a change. Oumar Diakite is going off and Will Still gives the last tactical orders to Amir Richardson (Reims).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Keito Nakamura (Reims) comes onto the pitch so that Reda Khadra can be given a rest.
70' Reda Khadra (Reims) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Brice Samba was alert and made a comfortable save.
69' A substitution has been made. Adrien Thomasson goes off and Florian Sotoca (Lens) comes on.
69' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) replaces Nampalys Mendy.
68' Wesley Said will be replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
68' CHANCE! Adrien Thomasson finds Angelo Fulgini (Lens) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
67' Facundo Medina (Lens) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
66' Good chance! Oumar Diakite (Reims) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
64' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Wesley Said (Lens) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
63' Thomas Foket (Reims) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
62' Good clearance! Oumar Diakite (Reims) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
61' Flag goes up against Reda Khadra (Reims) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
57' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
56' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

55' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
54' A VAR review has confirmed it's nothing more than a yellow card for Joseph Okumu (Reims).
53' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Joseph Okumu (Reims)! Let's see what he decides.
52' Joseph Okumu (Reims) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Millot and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
50' Reda Khadra (Reims) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
50' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
49' Nampalys Mendy (Lens) jumps into a tackle and Benoit Millot signals a foul. Reims have a free kick.
48' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims).
47' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Junya Ito (Reims) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Millot has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Wesley Said (Lens) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Przemyslaw Frankowski and easily beat the keeper with a header into the right side of the goal from close range. 1:1.
45+1' Lens showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Wesley Said (Lens) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
45' Sergio Akieme (Reims) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
41' 1 - 0 Goal! Oumar Diakite (Reims) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Junya Ito, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
40' The ball possession is 64:36.
39' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
38' Junya Ito (Reims) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
37' Sergio Akieme (Reims) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
36' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
35' Reda Khadra (Reims) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lens.
31' The resulting corner, taken by Teddy Teuma (Reims), comes to nothing.
30' Sergio Akieme (Reims) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee blows his whistle, Reims are awarded a corner kick.
29' The ball is played back to Nampalys Mendy (Lens), who controls it instantly and releases a piledriver from long range, but the shot lacks accuracy and drifts well wide of the left post.
29' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is caught offside!
27' Benoit Millot blows his whistle and it's Reda Khadra (Reims) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Benoit Millot stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
24' Wesley Said (Lens) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
22' Oumar Diakite (Reims) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
22' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
21' Oumar Diakite (Reims) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends a long ball forward to Oumar Diakite, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
19' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
18' Wasted opportunity! Oumar Diakite (Reims) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
17' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
15' Junya Ito (Reims) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
14' Some great controlled play and passing from Reims. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Wesley Said (Lens) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
7' Teddy Teuma (Reims) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
6' Wesley Said (Lens) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
5' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is flagged for offside.
3' A spell of possession for Reims in an attempt to control the game.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lens will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot is the one to supervise the game today.
